# LastJoyDevice

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Joystick](BlitzBasic-Joystick)

</div>


```blitzbasic
LastJoyDevice:Int32
```

**Returns:** The number of the joystick, or -1 if none was used yet.

## Description

Tells which joystick the user used last.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
While Not KeyHit(1)
	Cls
	Text 10, 10, "Last joystick: " + LastJoyDevice()
	Flip
Wend
```
